headline: Label recordings in Review
summary: 1 labelling task(s) are waiting in Review. After that, keep collecting recordings.

steps.title: Blind review: Not eating (Oct 26)
steps.detail: Open it in Review's blind workspace and mark every chew, or confirm there are none. Predictions stay hidden.

steps.title: Record 90-Second Baseline
steps.detail: 1 of 3 complete. Follow the on-screen prompts to the end, then send it to the Mac.

steps.title: Record Natural Meal
steps.detail: 0 of 3 complete. Follow the on-screen prompts to the end, then send it to the Mac.

steps.title: Optional: try the experimental model in Live
steps.detail: Live → Connect AirPods → New model check. It shows what the model detects; it is not an accuracy test yet.

checks.question: Can I test a model?
checks.answer: Yes, as an experiment: Live has the AirPods chewing-span model. Development F1 0.87 on one wearer's labels. Its accuracy in real use is not measured yet.

checks.question: Is visual chew detection working?
checks.answer: Partly. It runs on every recording and suggests chews. On 45 hand-marked chews it found 28 (F1 0.73 within ±250 ms; target 0.85). Use it as labelling help, not a chew counter yet.

checks.question: Do we need more data?
checks.answer: Yes. Have/need before the next model: verified chewing recordings 0/20, verified talking/walking/drinking/head-movement recordings 0/20, blind-reviewed test recordings 1/6, hand-marked chews 45/300.
